'''Garden of Izax''' was a garden located in the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] capital of [[Zakuul]] that was named after the deity [[Izax]]. Following the death of Empress [[Vaylin]] in [[3630 BBY]], the [[Eternal Fleet]] went rogue and blockaded the Spire. [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] passed through the garden on the way to the [[Eternal Throne]].<ref name="KotET" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garden of Izax appears as an area on Zakuul during the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' '''Chapter IX: The Eternal Throne'''.<ref name="KotET" />
